Digital Service Delivery / Salesforce / API Integration

From manual orientation scheduling to connected client experiences.

Led the design and delivery of a guided Salesforce scheduling experience that coordinates in-person and virtual client orientations, securely provisions location-specific Zoom meetings using Apex, and connects Salesforce events with website registration and communication workflows.

Systems LeadIntegration SpecialistScreen Flows + Queueable ApexZoom REST API
01 / Executive overview

One scheduling experience, three connected platforms.

Before the transformation, event staff coordinated Salesforce records, separately created virtual meetings in Zoom and transferred meeting details between systems. This repeated administration constrained how many orientation sessions could be offered.

The Salesforce solution supports date-range and selected-weekday scheduling, configurable times and duration, a review stage before records are created and automated Zoom provisioning for virtual sessions. The website provides location- and format-based session discovery and registration.

Engagement at a glance

My role: Systems Lead and Integration Specialist

Core records: Event/Workshop, Event Registration, Account and Program Component

Automation: Screen Flow, formula resources, collections and Apex Queueable callouts

Connected platforms: Zoom REST API and public website

02 / Problem and opportunity

Manual handoffs became a delivery constraint.

As-Is

Repeated event entry, Zoom meetings created separately, manual copying of links and host details, disconnected website publication, and staff-intensive registration communications.

To-Be

One guided scheduling operation creates proposed sessions for review; Salesforce creates the approved records and provisions virtual meeting details through Zoom. Website visitors discover events and register through a guided journey.

04 / Solution architecture

Salesforce is the operational hub for event scheduling and registration.

Experience layer

Internal scheduling staffScreen Flow for event details, date range or recurring days, and confirmation
Public-facing websiteLocation and attendance format selection, session availability and registration

Salesforce platform

Event-generation Screen FlowFormula-driven date logic, event collection, selectable exclusions, record creation
Event/WorkshopDates, location, capacity, Program Component, Zoom ID, Zoom status, host and virtual URL
Event RegistrationClient registration records and relationships to events and accounts
ZoomMeetingQueueableQueueable Apex with Database.AllowsCallouts and host mapping from custom metadata

Connected services

Zoom REST APIMeeting provisioning and meeting data returned to Salesforce
Website registrationAvailable sessions and web registration process
Client email notificationsConfirmation details and event reminders

The supplied Apex screenshot supports asynchronous HTTP callouts and mapping of hosts to event locations. Exact website API transport and retry mechanisms require source-code verification.

07 / Leadership and reported outcomes

Expanding service capacity with less routine scheduling work.

As Systems Lead and Integration Specialist, I led a 14-member cross-functional team through stakeholder discovery, process analysis, Salesforce administration, Zoom integration, solution validation, testing and delivery readiness.

Cross-functional team (14): 1 Director (project sponsor), 2 Managers (end-user representatives), 4 website developers (frontend and backend), 1 Salesforce Developer, 2 Salesforce Consultants, 1 Zoom Administrator, 1 additional Salesforce Administrator and 2 end users supporting UAT.

Project-reported outcomes. No operational dashboard has been supplied, so results are intentionally presented as supporting metrics rather than large headline scorecards.

+82%Orientation registrations
+74%Orientation attendance
>150%Events created
